context.description: Step 03b (hard gate): Validate TEST-DESIGNER output for IDN-05 before TEST-RUNNER may execute.

task.description:
Validate the IDN-05 test design. Check that:
1. Every MUST acceptance criterion from IDN-05 has a runnable integration test (no gaps)
2. No SkipZigTest on any MUST test case
3. Fixtures are isolated — no shared state between tests (each test creates its own tenant/group/role)
4. Tests are self-sufficient — they do not depend on ordering or external state
5. The test step test-integration-idn05 is properly wired in build.zig
6. TC-IDN05-06 and TC-IDN05-07 (EE-03 integration) cover the full activation path
7. TC-IDN05-05 (tenant isolation) genuinely tests cross-tenant boundary

Return PASS if all criteria met. FAIL with specific blocking issues if not.

result.summary: Rework re-validation PASS. All 7 MUST tests (TC-IDN05-01..TC-IDN05-07) implemented and runnable. TC-IDN05-05 provisions a real second tenant schema via provisionTenantSchema and asserts expectEqual(@as(u64,0), count_b) — cross-tenant isolation genuinely tested. No SkipZigTest present. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs with defer cleanup. test-integration-idn05 wired in build.zig. TC-IDN05-06 and TC-IDN05-07 cover EE-03 ROLE-to-GROUP resolution. lint_test_isolation.py exits 0. lint_handoffs.py exits 0.
